subject: Request: Trial top-up + promotional credits — legal review required
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@auroraops.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Julia Li <julia.li@auroraops.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for PoC — ask on credits and legal

Hi Stephanie / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We ran a quick internal review and have two blockers before procurement will cut a PO: a) the current trial cap is too small for our load profile; we need a 90-day extension and a top-up of credits to cover peak ingestion (~$25k-$30k estimated), and b) our legal team needs a simple addendum that clarifies data residency + audit access for the PoC period.

Can Redwood do a 90-day top-up of $25k in trial credits and a one-page addendum? If you can provide a short term-sheet and a doc we can pass to our legal team that would accelerate the PO.

We are motivated to move quickly — if the PoC is successful we are prepared to commit to a paid Dedicated capacity within Q3, but procurement needs these items before signing.

Attachments: [Aurora_PoC_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Platform
Aurora Ops

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@auroraops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Julia Li <julia.li@auroraops.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for PoC — ask on credits and legal

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can support a 90-day extension and a promotional credit package to cover peak usage. Proposed offer (subject to internal approval & legal sign-off):
- 90-day PoC extension starting on signing of the addendum
- $25,000 in trial credits applied to your account (one-time top-up)
- If Aurora converts to Dedicated within 60 days of PoC completion, we’ll apply a 20% credit back against the first invoice (applies to committed spend only)

I’m attaching a short term-sheet that lists the credit mechanics and a draft one-page addendum for legal review. Can you confirm your legal contact (is Julia the right person to review) and whether your security team needs additional artifacts (SOC2 report, data flow diagrams)?

If Aurora is ok with the above, I’ll route for executive approval this afternoon and loop in finance/legal to generate the addendum for your signatures.

[Attachment: RDW_trial_term_sheet_v2.pdf]

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aurora — trial top-up + addendum request (deal RDW-2027-AUR-453)

Team —

Forwarding Aurora's ask. Quick summary: they want a 90-day extension + $25k trial credit. They’re pre-procurement with clear intent to convert if PoC shows throughput and latency targets. Risk: promotional credit is ~25k (we’d apply to hosted account). Upside: high likelihood of Dedicated conversion; CEP view estimates $120k ARR within 12 months if they convert.

Requesting:
- Approval to offer $25k promo credit + 20% conversion credit (as noted in my reply)
- Legal to approve 1-page addendum (data residency + audit clause) and sign within 48 hours

Impact / notes:
- Finance: this is a one-off marketing/promotional expense; we should flag for PSR (promo spend review).
- Ops: recommend we lock model variant to a smaller instance family during PoC to manage cost.

Can I get sign-off by EOD PT? If we have buy-in, I’ll push the addendum to them and request a PO.

— Stephanie

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora — trial top-up + addendum request (deal RDW-2027-AUR-453)

+1 to approving the credits. Good motion to push them across the line — the ARR upside looks solid. Please reduce the trial credit ask to $25k (as they requested) and hold the 20% conversion credit contingent on a minimum 12-month committed contract.

Marissa / Aditya — can you OK the promotional spend? If you want finance to track this, add to the PSR queue under Q3 promotions.

Ben
VP, Sales

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 00:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora — trial top-up + addendum request (deal RDW-2027-AUR-453)

Thanks for the context. Approve the 90-day extension and the $25k trial credit. Conditions:
- Reduce promotional payout exposure by capping applied credits per month (suggest $12.5k/mo for two months)
- Conversion credit (20%) only applies if Aurora signs a >=12 month committed Dedicated contract and the first invoice >= $50k MRR equivalent in committed spend over the first 3 billing cycles
- Legal: finalize one-page addendum, ensure standard data-residency language and audit access clause; require DPO contact for any extra data requests

Stephanie — please send the attached one-page addendum to Samira and Julia with the updated monthly cap language. Copy the HubSpot deal and add the PSR ticket: PSR-7892. Once signed, send DocuSign link and request PO.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations (interim)
